safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “dry” skin and mislocalizing the main distribution (back vs hands/arms) is unlikely to change immediate management in an uncomplicated pruritic dermatitis/eczema flare, but it reduces documentation accuracy for follow-up comparison. Clinical harm risk is minimal because key symptom (itchy rash) and timeframe are still captured.

Expected harm is usually limited to prolonged symptoms and additional follow-up/treatment.
